name: andvari-web
description: andvari web client — independent TypeScript implementation of spec/
overridesComment: Both entries are TRANSITIVE build-time deps of vite — never shipped in the bundle — so they are pinned here rather than added as phantom direct dependencies or forced through an unneeded vite major. postcss <=8.5.17 (GHSA): path traversal via sourceMappingURL auto-loading. nanoid <3.3.17 (GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8): customAlphabet/customRandom spin forever when called with size 0; it reaches us only through postcss, and nothing in this tree calls those functions — the pin exists so the repository's OpenSSF Scorecard vulnerability check stays clean, which for a public password manager is part of the product.
